name: Scale of Old Murk-Eye
summary: On Westfall's coast, Old Murk-Eye terrorizes the shore. Captain Grayson, the ghost at Westfall Lighthouse, needs a scale from the murloc as proof of his death.

sections.title: Trophy of a Coastal Scourge
sections.body: Old Murk-Eye turned Westfall's coast into a killing ground. Captain Grayson, the ghost bound to Westfall Lighthouse, says the cunning murloc rallied weaker-minded murlocs to raid the shore. Murk-Eye drove away the keeper's family, leaving the beacon dark when Grayson's ship struck the rocks. When the family returned to relight the flame, Murk-Eye attacked again and slaughtered them. Grayson seeks a scale from the creature as proof that the shore is clear of its fiercest predator.

faq.q: What is the Scale of Old Murk-Eye used for?
aliases: scale of old murk eye use
faq.answer: Captain Grayson needs the scale as proof that Old Murk-Eye is dead. The ghost haunts the rocky isle of Westfall Lighthouse and seeks vengeance because Murk-Eye left the beacon dark when Grayson's ship wrecked, then slaughtered the lighthouse keeper's family.
Old Murk-Eye is a vicious, cunning murloc leader who prowls Westfall's sandy shores. He can organize and coerce his kin into deadly, coordinated raids against shoreline outposts.

faq.q: Why did Old Murk-Eye target the lighthouse?
faq.answer: Old Murk-Eye first raided the lighthouse to drive away the keeper and his family, leaving the coast in darkness. When they returned to relight the flame, he rallied his kin for another attack and murdered the whole family, leaving ships blind to the dangerous coastal shoals.

angles.text: As an Alliance sailor traveling the Great Sea toward Stormwind, helping end Old Murk-Eye's attacks can keep the Westfall beacon lit and vessels from striking the rocks.
